item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las shar du rgyal po'i gsang mdos
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug (phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrab pa/ dkyil 'khor stong dang nyis brgya'i gzhung lugs bcud du dril ba las/ shar du rgyal po'i gsang mdos 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi smar byang / mkhas pa de nyid kyis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la grub pa snyems (bsnyems) nas/ bka' ni gsang ba'i brag la sbas/ man ngag ni gsang ba'i rig 'dzin nyid kyi thugs la gab bo/ phyis su rten 'brel skabs su bab pa'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub du babs pa 'di yang / mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che spyang 'phags gdung grol/ mnyam med tshul khrims dbang drag (grags) mchog gis bka' gsung bde chen rgyan du phebs (phab)pa dang*/ ma zad rigs mthun grogs po bka' slob pa tshul khrims blo gros dang / drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims sogs nas rten 'brel legs pa'i rtags bcas te bskul cing*/ mi dbang bsod nams 'brug rgyal gyis dri bral mig shel lha dar bcas nas yang yang bskul pa la brten nas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du/ rgod rje'i rigs rus su gtogs pa'i kho bo tha shal ba/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'bring 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am u0f38gsang ming g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ dkar chag yi ge ris su btab pa'o//
